"""Source-only inspection of emitted SDK HTTP traffic; no AIP imports or answer oracle."""
import json
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

out = Path(sys.argv[1])
ids = dict(line.split('=', 1) for line in (out / 'identities.env').read_text().splitlines())
c1_at = datetime.fromisoformat(sys.argv[2])
counts = Counter()
first, last, overlap = {}, {}, defaultdict(list)

def attributes(items):
    return {item['key']: next(iter(item['value'].values())) for item in items}

for line in (out / 'otlp.jsonl').read_text().splitlines():
    for resource_spans in json.loads(line)['resourceSpans']:
        resource = attributes(resource_spans['resource']['attributes'])
        for scope in resource_spans['scopeSpans']:
            for span in scope['spans']:
                start = datetime.fromtimestamp(int(span['startTimeUnixNano']) / 1e9, UTC)
                end = datetime.fromtimestamp(int(span['endTimeUnixNano']) / 1e9, UTC)
                assert start.date().isoformat() == end.date().isoformat() == ids['DAY']
                assert end >= start
                if span['kind'] not in (3, 'SPAN_KIND_CLIENT'):
                    continue
                pod = resource['k8s.pod.uid']
                assert pod in (ids['P1_UID'], ids['P2_UID'])
                target = 'pricing' if pod == ids['P1_UID'] else 'legacy-pricing'
                attrs = attributes(span['attributes'])
                assert attrs['http.request.method'] == 'GET'
                assert attrs['url.full'] == 'http://' + target + '/prices'
                assert attrs['peer.service'] == target
                assert int(attrs['http.response.status_code']) == 200
                counts[target] += 1
                first[pod] = min(first.get(pod, start), start)
                last[pod] = max(last.get(pod, end), end)
                if end <= c1_at:
                    overlap[pod].append(start)
for pod in (ids['P1_UID'], ids['P2_UID']):
    assert len(overlap[pod]) > 1
    assert (max(overlap[pod]) - min(overlap[pod])).total_seconds() >= 300
result = {
    'source_inspection': 'PASS',
    'utc_day': ids['DAY'],
    'successful_real_client_http_requests': dict(counts),
    'first_client_span': {key: value.isoformat() for key, value in first.items()},
    'last_client_span': {key: value.isoformat() for key, value in last.items()},
    'pre_c1_observed_traffic_seconds': {pod: (max(values) - min(values)).total_seconds() for pod, values in overlap.items()},
    'aip_evaluation': 'NOT_RUN',
}
(out / 'recording-inspection.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
